steps.statement: Verify the Database Mode and Role on Primary & DR Nodes
syntax: select name, open_mode, database_role from v$database;
output: On Primary: - Mode - READ WRITE, ROLE – PRIMARY
On Standby: - Mode – MOUNTED, ROLE – STANDBY

steps.statement: Verify the Job Status on Primary Node
syntax: select name, value from v$parameter where name='job_queue_processes';

steps.statement: Verify the Log Sequence Number on Primary & DR Node
syntax: select thread#, max(sequence#) from v$log_history group by thread#;

steps.statement: Switch the log on database on Primary Node (If Available)
Shut down the database on Primary Node (If Available)
Switch the log on database on Primary Node1
Verify the Log Sequence Number on Primary & DR Node
syntax: select thread#, max(sequence#) from v$log_history group by thread#;

steps.statement: Verify the Switchover status for database is TO_STANDBY or SESSIONS ACTIVE on Primary Node1
Switch the role of the Database from Primary to Standby on Primary Node
Start the database in mount state on the New DR Node
Verify the Switchover status for database is TO_PRIMARY or SESSIONS ACTIVE on Original DR Node
Switch the role of the Database from Standby to Primary on Original DR Node
syntax: alter database commit to switchover to primary

steps.statement: Shutdown the database post switching the role from Standby to Primary on Original DR Node
Start the database in Read Write mode on New Primary Node
Start the database in standby mode on New DR Node (If Available)
Verify the Database Mode and Role on DR & Primary & Nodes post Switchover
syntax: select name, open_mode, database_role from v$database
output: On New Primary: - Mode - READ WRITE, ROLE – PRIMARY
On New Standby: -  Mode – MOUNTED, ROLE - STANDBY

steps.statement: Switch the log on database on New Primary Node 1 alter system switch logfile;
Start the recovery for database from DR to Primary on New DR Node alter database recover managed standby database disconnect from session;
syntax: alter database recover managed standby database disconnect from session;

steps.statement: Verify the Log Sequence Number on New DR & Primary Nodes select thread#, max(sequence#) from v$log_history group by thread#;
syntax: select thread#, max(sequence#) from v$log_history group by thread#;
